name: CARV English
description: CARV English is a center stage theater club based in Bangalore. Established in 2001, the troupe performs stage plays at major inter collegiate fests across India and also hosts their independent flagship events - Coliseum & Productions.

events.name: Theater Play Showcase
events.detail: Members will put on a theatrical performance to introduce the club. After this an acting worskhop will be held.

events.name: Emotion Quadrant Game
events.detail: Engaging game to teach the students how to express and sustain different emotions and how it works in theater

events.name: Improv game
events.detail: Fun game that allows the audience and players to be more spontaneous and creative. to encourages thinking beyond a script

events.name: Jeopardy
events.detail: Theater based quizzes and interactive games.
